name: signet-core-1
summary: Bitcoin Core 31.1 on signet: one wallet that receives on p2sh-segwit and changes to bech32 (-addresstype=p2sh-segwit -changetype=bech32), paying two other wallets of the same node (legacy, p2sh-segwit, bech32 and bech32m recipients in turn) at a tiny scale: about 34,000 satoshis from the faucet at 1 sat/vB, odd amounts of 600 to 2,100 satoshis and some of 10,000, with what the other two wallets held sent back between rounds (tools/bench/drive_core.py and run_plan.py, docs/benchmark-wallets.md scaled down). Two batches (7 recipients) and one send-everything of 5 coins are marked as such by the person who made them; every other transaction counts as a payment, and the 22 incoming transactions are the faucet and the refills. The change of each transaction is the output on its change chain.

wallet_software.core: Bitcoin Core 31.1, addresstype=p2sh-segwit, changetype=bech32, consolidatefeerate=1 sat/vB
